lyd_adopt_yanli_effect = {
    if = {
        limit = { lyd_can_change_school_trigger = yes NOT = { rite = rite:lyd_rite_yanli } }
        set_character_rite = rite:lyd_rite_yanli
        if = {
            limit = { rite = rite:lyd_rite_yanli faith = rite:lyd_rite_yanli.faith }
            add_character_flag = { flag = lyd_school_cooldown days = 365 }
        }
        else = { debug_log = "LYD_SCHOOL_RITE_POSTCONDITION_FAILED" trigger_event = lyd.2 }
    }
}
